about: T3 phone references (decision 19). Placeholder habits and trackers only (Walk, Water), made for this survey in apps we installed or our own debug builds; screenshots in the gitignored _screens-sources/t3/. Bounds in dp (1080 px = 384 dp, density 450).

habits_list.name: Loop Habit Tracker 2.3.1
habits_list.presence: score ring left of the name (fills with the habit's score)
habits_list.days_shown: the last 4 days as columns, newest first; header row with weekday and date
habits_list.missed_mark: a grey cross on every day not done (yes/no habit); 0 glasses on a counted one
habits_list.log_from_list: tap a day cell: a popup with a note field and two buttons, tick and cross (yesBtn [88,422,103,48], noBtn [192,422,103,48]); the cell itself is [189,133,48,48]

habits_list.name: Tendril (source app)
habits_list.days_shown: one day at a time (previous and next day arrows, the day's name)
habits_list.done_mark: a checkbox (yes/no); a counted habit has a plus button, Add one more
habits_list.grouping: by time block (Morning 06:30-09:00, Midday, Afternoon, Evening, Night), then Any time today; empty blocks still listed
habits_list.log_from_list: 1 tap: the checkbox, or the plus button for a count
habits_list.rule_seen: on the add-habit sheet, under a counted habit's daily number: 'A number you set for yourself. The row and the sheet count what you did; the number is shown once, in the sheet, and never as a fraction, a bar or a percentage.'
habits_list.switches: Tasks, Habits, Merged segments; By time and Day menus

habit_logging.form: popup over the list: note field above tick and cross buttons, 103x48 dp each

conflict_for_owner: T1's approved Today row for a counted habit reads '3 of 8 · next block 14:00', a fraction; Tendril's rule forbids fractions. Both forms are scored in T3.1.

trackers_list.name: Chronicle (source app), Data tab
trackers_list.row: a card per tracker: a kind glyph in a circle (# for a number), the name, a line under it, '+ Log' as a filled pill at the right
trackers_list.says: 'no entries yet'; after one reading '1 today · last just now'; an older one 'last 8d ago'
trackers_list.group: category headers with a count and a fold chevron ('Uncategorised 2'); Checklists in the same screen below; Quick add (a typed log line) folded at the top
trackers_list.log: + Log opens a sheet: Quick (presets) with Set, a − value + stepper, Label, Note, When, Save (2 taps for a stepped 1); a 'Logged' toast
trackers_list.new_tracker: a sheet: Name; Type chips Number, Yes / No, Rating, Choice; Unit chips (None, hours, km, times, pages, reps, steps, cal, Custom); 'Set a default value (1-tap logging)' switch; Direction (No preference, Higher is better, Lower is better); Category; Add tracker
trackers_list.activities: the Track tab: activities as cards with a round play button (timer), 'last: 5 ott'; its + makes an activity (name, colour wheel, icon, category)

trackers_list.name: Track & Graph
trackers_list.row: a grid of two columns of cards: a ⋮ menu, the name centred, the last time under it ('No Data', '1 minuto fa'), a + at the bottom right; graphs and groups are cards in the same grid
trackers_list.says: the last time only, never a value
trackers_list.group: groups are cards that open; flat inside
trackers_list.log: + opens a dialog: date and time buttons, Value filled with 1 and the number keypad up, '+ Add a label' and '+ Add a note' folded as chips, Cancel and Add (2 taps); a three-page tutorial the first time
trackers_list.new_tracker: a page: Tracker name, an optional description, 'This is a time or duration', Advanced options folded; Create
trackers_list.empty: 'Welcome to Track & Graph! Tap + in the top right and select Tracker to get started.'

trackers_list.name: Loop Habit Tracker 2.3.1 (a measurable habit)
trackers_list.row: the habits list row: score ring, name, the last 4 days as cells each with the amount and unit ('0 glasses')
trackers_list.says: a number per day in each cell
trackers_list.log: a tap on a day cell opens a popup: Note, the value with the system number keypad, Salva (3 taps with typing)

activities_list.name: Chronicle (source app), Track tab
activities_list.row: a card per activity: its icon in a tinted circle, the name, 'last: 5 ott', a round filled ▶ at the right
activities_list.group: category headers with a count and a fold ('Uncategorised 1'), Archived folded at the foot; Quick add (a typed log line) folded at the top
activities_list.running: a strip on Track while a session runs (feature-spec: 'Start, a strip on Track, Stop')
activities_list.plan: the Start button's menu: Start now, and Last used (the plan this activity last ran) or Last used… (the planner, when there is none); from Break Down Timer's timed run (feature-spec 2026-09-24)
activities_list.new_activity: a sheet: Name, Colour (a wheel, a shade slider, Hex), Icon (seven), Category
